test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Two express trains of length 320 m and 380 m started moving from Ahmedabad to Delhi at the same time. Their speeds are 84 km/h and 42 km/h, respectively. In how many seconds will the faster train cross the slower train?
solution:
Given:

Speed of Train1 = 42 km/h

Speed of Train2 = 84 km/h

Length of the trains = 320m and 380m

Formula used:

If the two bodies having speed S1 and S2, travelling in same direction, then their Relative speed = S1 - S2

If the two bodies having speed S1 and S2, travelling in opposite direction, then their Relative speed = S1 + S2

Distance traveled = Speed × Time

Calculation:

Relative speed of trains = (Length of both trains)/Time

⇒ 5/18 × (84 – 42) = (320 + 380)/Time

⇒ 210/18 = 700/Time

∴ Time = 60 sec

**The answer is 60 sec.**
